author: Business Standard Companies Desk
headline: Mumbai-based Mintoak acquires ICC Loyalty to deepen presence in West Asia
snippet: Mintoak, the Mumbai-headquartered merchant payments SaaS platform, has acquired Dubai-based loyalty technology company ICC Loyalty as it looks to deepen its presence in the West Asian market and expand beyond payments into customer engagement and rewards.

author: Inc42 Newsdesk
headline: Mintoak Acquires UAE-Based ICC Loyalty To Expand Fintech Stack For Banks
snippet: The acquisition will help Mintoak's banking partners unlock new revenue opportunities beyond payments, with the combined business generating over $30 million in annual revenue at a profitability margin exceeding 30%.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Mintoak acquires Middle East-headquartered fintech ICC Loyalty
snippet: Mintoak announced today it has acquired ICC Loyalty, expanding its footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Eastern Europe and Asia while helping banks unlock new revenue opportunities beyond payments.

author: PR Newswire APAC
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Visa announced a partnership with Mintoak, a merchant SaaS fintech platform, to enable acquirers across Asia Pacific to strengthen their merchant propositions beyond core payment acceptance, moving toward platform-led models.

author: PR Newswire (syndicated)
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: The partnership integrates omnichannel payment acceptance across card-present and card-not-present environments with value-added services such as reporting, merchant engagement tools, and integrated banking solutions.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Acquirers across the Asia Pacific region will gain access to Mintoak's platform-led merchant experience through the new Visa partnership, the companies said.

author: The Paypers Editorial
headline: Visa and Mintoak partner on merchant SaaS for Asia Pacific acquirers
snippet: The collaboration is aimed at helping acquiring banks in Asia Pacific move from transaction-led acquiring to platform-led merchant servicing models.

author: PR Newswire (syndicated)
headline: Visa and Mintoak Join Forces to Bring Merchant SaaS Capabilities to Acquirers Across Asia Pacific
snippet: Visa and Mintoak's partnership will help acquirers deliver a digital-first merchant experience across the Asia Pacific region.

author: CXOToday Desk
headline: Mintoak announces partnership with Axis Bank to enable SMEs with merchant payments and business solutions
snippet: Axis Bank will utilise Mintoak's white-labelled mobile SaaS platform, enabling SMEs to accept payments, access transaction reports, and submit service requests directly through the app.

author: FinTech Magazine Staff
headline: India's fintech SaaS platform Mintoak receives $20mn backing
snippet: Mintoak raised $20 million in a Series A funding round led by PayPal Ventures, as the merchant payments platform looks to scale its bank-embedded SaaS offering.

author: Business Standard Companies Desk
headline: HDFC Bank to acquire 7.75% stake in Mintoak Innovations
snippet: HDFC Bank, India's largest private bank, will acquire a 7.75% stake in Mintoak Innovations on a fully diluted basis for a cash consideration of $3.7 million, as part of a strategic partnership starting with payments.

author: PR Newswire
headline: Mintoak develops merchant solutions to fuel business growth for MSMEs
snippet: Mintoak's modular, API-first merchant platform is designed to help India's MSME merchants access payments, lending, and engagement tools through their banking partners.

author: IndiaInfoline Leaders Speak
headline: Raman Khanduja, Co-founder and CEO, Mintoak Innovations
snippet: In this leadership interview, Mintoak co-founder and CEO Raman Khanduja discusses the company's embedded-fintech strategy and its roadmap for bank partnerships across India, the Middle East and Africa.
